title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user who can view and edit containers in at least one container…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permissions to view and edit containers in at least one container label can create artifacts linked to containers and artifacts outside those labels. This flaw allows exposure of fields from restricted artifacts and unauthorized modification of incident lineage due to insufficient verification of access rights to parent containers and artifacts during artifact creation.
